newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Shamrock limit up in listing debut.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Shamrock limit up in listing debut.

text.p: Shamrock Technology soared limit-up during its debut on Taiwan's stock exchange on Friday and brokers expected the rise to continue into next week.
After 70 minutes, Shamrock was up the daily seven percent limit, or T$2.50, to T$39.
Shamrock is a major Taiwan maker of computer monitors.

"The computer monitor business has been big in Taiwan for a long time, despite low profit margins and investors are, in general, pretty optimistic about Shamrock's outlook," said Wang Jieh of Foremost Investment.
"I would expect its share prices to continue rising at least until early next week," he added.
Taiwan leads the world in computer monitor production.
